parsed.explanation: Worst documented features are tier-1 traveller-facing: entry screening can refuse a visa where documents raise doubt about sex, with possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, and foreign governments issued advisories after detentions of trans/nonbinary citizens over visa issues; the athlete entry ban shows explicit exclusion. Facilities bans cover ~21 states (criminal trespass in four, one documented arrest), and immigration custody shows documented beating, forced labour and sexual abuse — detention severity is severe. Offsetting: no criminalisation of trans identity, a national gender-identity hate-crime statute, 22 states plus the capital outlawing discrimination, functioning courts (though also used against trans people), and no documented trans-specific violence rate. Rhetoric and bounty/terrorism language are hostile but not shown to target visitors. Severe exposure concentrated in documents, entry and facilities, without organised state sweeps of trans people: High Risk, upper end.
